column9: Sample product name "Westland Peated" - name-based evidence the release itself is peated; exact intensity not independently confirmed (no current westlanddistillery.com page located this session), "heavy" is this session's best estimate for a dedicated peated craft release contrasted against the unpeated core range, unchanged from the seed round's own estimate.

Chapter 7's own site (fetched this session) lists multiple "Prologue Peated" editions/batches (Edition 4 2024, World Edition 2/3) distinct from the standard unpeated Prologue vatting. Exact ppm not stated by the producer; "heavy" reflects independent review language ("buckets of peat", "a peated option for peat lovers") describing the same release.
